conviction_note: Full-year print where the FY2026 beat is already public (Q3 cumulative ordinary profit 100.2% of the never-revised plan), so the reaction turns on two items the release adds: the FY2027 guide (FY25's +58% guide went limit-up +20.9%, FY26's +4.5% guide gapped -9.75% and closed -0.9%) and the year-end dividend under a 30% payout policy. The dividend and the +75% backlog lean positive; the real-estate-inflated FY26 base, which a conservative FY27 guide could show as a decline, and a 32.7x margin-long overhang lean negative. Findings sum to +1.0, the scaled number is +0.32 (abs 8.0, p_up 52), and the gap is the honest width of an unknown guide.
bar: Company FY2026 plan, unchanged since 2025-10-10: sales 20,000m, OP 1,800m, ordinary 1,750m, NP 1,100m, EPS 158.57, dividend 48 yen (Q3 tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593221.pdf). No IFIS consensus (kabuyoho shows none: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=1434) and 四季報 not reachable, so the street's own bar is unsourced; print_vs_bar is FY OP vs the company plan (~2,250m expected vs 1,800m) and every finding is capped accordingly. There is no bar at all for the FY2027 guide.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (absent, no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 32.68x (baseline; kabutan header 2026-10-14). irbank margin series shows margin longs building into and after the July Q3 print: 224,600 shares 07-10 -> 288,300 on 07-17 (+63,700), ratio 137x, about 4.1% of 6.96m shares, bought around 1,750-1,940 yen vs spot 1,644 (https://irbank.net/1434/margin). No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.92, driven by margin overhang.

findings.finding: The FY2026 beat is mechanically certain and large: 9M OP 1,736m vs FY plan 1,800m (96%), ordinary 1,754m vs 1,750m (100.2%, against a 5-year average 71.8% at Q3), and Q4 (Jun-Aug) is seasonally the largest quarter (OP 928m in FY25 Q4, 778m in FY24 Q4), so FY OP plausibly lands ~2.2-2.5bn, +25-40% vs the unrevised plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 and Q2 beats bought limit-up (+20.8% 2026-01-15, +21.3% 2026-04-14); the Q3 beat that exceeded the full-year plan without a raise sold -2.73% (gap -5.61%) on 2026-07-15 and the stock drifted from 1,943 to ~1,600.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 進捗率 has been public since July and the stock fell after it. What is not public is the Q4 size; at 1,644 the stock trades at 10.4x the plan EPS of 158 and ~8x a 200+ EPS actual, so the price is not holding a large Q4. Sized small because the beat itself is visible.
findings.independence: Same company data as kabutan's finance page https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1434 (quarterly OP history); one fact.

findings.finding: Dividend policy is a payout ratio (30% in FY26, stepping to 40% by FY28, with FY25's 40 yen as floor); the 48 yen plan is exactly 30% of the 158.57 plan EPS, and 9M EPS is already 157.35, so applying the stated payout to the actual EPS implies a year-end dividend of roughly 57-65 yen, plus a FY27 forecast at a higher payout, announced in the same batch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-14: commemorative 10-yen dividend raise with a weak Q3, stock -4.91% next session; 2025-10-10: '8円増配へ' with a flat guide, gap -9.75%, close -0.90%. So dividends have not on their own carried this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Yield screens quote 2.92-2.96% on the 48 yen plan (kabutan, irbank 2026-10-13); if the market held a ~60 yen dividend it would read near 3.7% and the stock would not sit at 1.36x book after a 36% fall from May. Not raised at Q3 (修正の有無：無), so nothing has pre-released it. Inference from the policy, not a company statement of the number.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin confirms no dividend revision through 2026-07-14 and plan EPS 158.57: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593221.pdf

findings.finding: Order backlog at 2026-05-31 was 12,933m against 7,398m a year earlier (+75%), domestic EPC backlog 12,505m vs 6,794m, 9M orders +62.8% (BESS, communications/security, defence facilities), with solar/BESS revenue slipping (期ずれ) on grid connection; that carries into FY2027 domestic EPC revenue and supports a growth guide toward the FY28 mid-term target of OP 2.5bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last FY guides: FY25 guided +58% OP on 2024-10-15 -> limit-up +20.92%; FY26 guided +4.5% OP on 2025-10-10 -> gap -9.75%, close -0.90%.
findings.why_not_priced: The backlog is public but the guide is not; a stock at ~8x likely FY26 EPS is not pricing growth off this base. If the market expected a growth guide it would not have de-rated from 2,522 (2026-05-12) to 1,644.
findings.independence: Q2 deck shows H1 orders 13,689m vs 7,544m and the mid-term plan targets (sales 25bn, OP 2.5bn in FY28): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260422/140120260422508218.pdf. Shares the Q3 tanshin with finding 4.

findings.finding: FY2026 profit is inflated by real-estate sales (9M real-estate segment profit 797m on 4,161m of sales from two property disposals, vs a planned H2 of just 35m), and the company is moving real estate to a hold-and-rent model, so a FY2027 guide set from the mid-term path (FY28 OP 2.5bn, linear ~2.15bn for FY27) could print as a decline against a ~2.2-2.5bn FY26 actual; last year's flat guide was met with a -9.75% gap.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is unknown until the release; kabutan's headline will read '今期経常はX%減益' if it is below the FY26 actual, which for a retail-heavy register with 32.7x margin longs is the setup in which there are sellers. Inference on the company's guide habit, not a document; sized small with a wide low tail.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin segment detail (two property sales, 不動産再生型 model shift): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593221.pdf; same company documents as finding 3.

findings.finding: Margin longs piled in on the July Q3 print (+63,700 shares to 288,300 in the week to 07-17, ratio 137x; 32.68x now), roughly 4% of shares outstanding and well over ten days of current ~20-40k turnover, bought around 1,750-1,940 and now underwater, which supplies sellers into any post-release strength.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the July print the stock fell from 1,943 to 1,750 within three sessions while margin longs rose; April's limit-up followed a lower ratio (6-60x).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced already in the baseline lean (margin_overhang -0.76); filed small because it caps upside rather than predicting a sign.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed ahead of the print, so the FY26 actual vs plan lands with the release (beat near-certain, already visible via 進捗率 100.2%). Returns: payout-policy dividend raise likely (48 yen plan vs ~57-65 yen at 30% of actual EPS); no buyback history found. New-year guide: the decisive item, no consensus; the last two FY guides moved the stock +20.9% and -9.75% (gap). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative ordinary 100.2% vs 5-year average 71.8%, and 45.0% at the same point last year.
baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.92, all margin overhang) and the flat run-up (+3.2% 20d, +0.67% 5d) say little; the strongest positive the release could carry is a payout-driven dividend raise plus a growth guide off a +75% backlog, which I looked for and filed, and the strongest negative is a mid-term-path FY27 guide that reads as a decline off a real-estate-inflated FY26, so the evidence nets to a slight lean up with a very wide two-sided band.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (visible 進捗率/月次 misses toward 50) concerns negatives resting on public series, and my one 進捗率 finding is a small positive already sized as mostly priced; rule 2 (negative tilt) is satisfied, with three positives against two negatives and the strongest positive (dividend) searched and filed; the run-in open question does not apply (5d run-up +0.67%).
